note: Everything needed to reproduce the shipped core binary. Nothing here points at a checkout outside this repository: a fresh clone plus Docker is the whole toolchain. `make core` refuses to package an artifact whose sha256 does not match, so this file is the contract between the build and the pak.

patch.note: Keeps upstream data beside the core, supplies handheld-first input defaults, and disables unsupported hardware rendering by default.

build_dependencies.name: libretro-deps
build_dependencies.note: Pinned by the upstream libretro backend's dependencies.mk; recorded here so the pin is visible without reading the source.

toolchain.note: Public image, pullable anonymously. Pin the digest below once you have verified a build; a tag can move under you and a moved toolchain changes the binary.

artifact.note: Recorded from two clean builds in the digest-pinned toolchain image on 2026-08-29. The build passes the source revision explicitly and applies the hash-pinned Leaf patch before compilation. CI is the independent verifier; investigate any mismatch rather than overwriting this value.
